note: Four hand-authored personas for the NICE-aligned diabetes review grader. calculateControl short-circuits to controlLevel 'draft' (score 0, no rules) whenever fewer than 2 of the 8 scored Likert/percentage items are answered AND no HbA1c is entered; otherwise controlScore is a weighted-average composite (HbA1c band 0/20/40/60/80/100 seeded as the base with weight 4, then medication adherence, diet adherence, and time-in-range each folded in at weight 1, then a complication penalty of min(5 x count, 30) subtracted) and controlLevel bands on that score (<=20 veryPoor, <=40 poor, <65 suboptimal, else wellControlled). detectAdditionalFlags is a split engine (mirrors form-app.js's own call: detectAdditionalFlags(state)) so its output is pinned here via flagsHint. FIXED 2026-09-06 (was a VERIFIED ENGINE GAP, documented rather than silently patched at the time): retinopathyStatus has five options (none, background, preProliferative, proliferative, maculopathy) but only 'background' (DM-008, medium) and 'proliferative' (DM-004, high; FLAG-EYE-001) used to have a dedicated rule or flag — 'preProliferative' and 'maculopathy' correctly counted toward countComplications() (so they still depressed the composite score and correctly suppressed DM-017's 'no complications' rule) but raised no eye-specific rule or flag at all, so a clinician reading only the fired-rules/flags list saw no signal that a sight-threatening finding was recorded. Fixed by adding DM-021 (pre-proliferative, high concern) and DM-022 (maculopathy, high concern) to the rule catalogue (`sql/09_insert_diabetes_rule_dm021_dm022.sql` seeds the reference table), and FLAG-EYE-003 / FLAG-EYE-004 (both 'high' priority) to the flag detector — both graded 'high', matching DM-004/proliferative's urgency, per the National Diabetic Eye Screening Programme's R1/R2/R3 grading and NICE NG28 (both pre-proliferative and maculopathy warrant the same urgent ophthalmology referral pathway as proliferative retinopathy, not routine annual re-screening). FIXED 2026-09-07: FLAG-EYE-001 and 3 other flags (FLAG-HBA1C-001, FLAG-HYPO-002, FLAG-FOOT-001) in the HTML engine's flagged-issues.js used priority: 'urgent' -- a value the SQL grade_flag.priority CHECK constraint and the SvelteKit reference's FlagPriority type both reject (only high/medium/low are valid; verified by grep against the actual file before fixing -- 4 flags, not the '6 of 18'/'five other flags' figure this note and tasks.md previously carried). All 4 now use 'high', matching the Svelte reference's pre-existing value for the same 4 flag IDs exactly, so the fix required no new clinical judgement -- Svelte had already made the correct call. Separate, pre-existing stack-parity gap found while verifying the Svelte side and fixed in the same pass: FLAG-CVD-002 (current smoker) and FLAG-CVD-003 (systolic BP >= 140) existed only in the HTML engine and had never been ported to front-end-with-svelte/src/lib/engine/flagged-issues.ts; ported verbatim (both use the same 'high'/'medium' priorities in both stacks, so this did not interact with the priority fix). The 'Critical' persona below (the only one exercising FLAG-HBA1C-001 / FLAG-HYPO-002 / FLAG-FOOT-001 / FLAG-EYE-001 / FLAG-CVD-002 / FLAG-CVD-003 all at once) had its `expected.additionalFlags` regenerated via bin/test-personas diabetes-assessment --update; the flag set and every other field are unchanged, only the 4 priority strings and their consequent sort position.

personas.name: Well-controlled type 2, engaged and physically active
personas.description: HbA1c 48 mmol/mol (exactly at the <=48 band, hba1cScore 100), no complications, good medication and diet adherence (5/5 each), 85% time-in-range, regular physical activity, low distress and good coping. Composite: base 100 (weight 4) folded with adherence 100 (weight 1) -> (100*4+100)/5=100, diet 100 (weight 1) -> (100*5+100)/6=100, TIR 85 (weight 1) -> (100*6+85)/7=97.857142... -> round 98; no complications so no penalty. Expect controlLevel 'wellControlled', controlScore 98, and low-concern rules DM-016 (HbA1c at target), DM-017 (no complications), DM-018 (good diet), DM-019 (active), DM-020 (good psych) in registry order; no medium/high rules. Flags: none (no threshold in flagged-issues.js is crossed; hba1cTarget 53 >= hba1cValue 48 so FLAG-HBA1C-002 does not fire).

personas.name: Pre-proliferative retinopathy - now correctly flagged for urgent eye referral
personas.description: FIXED 2026-09-06 (was 'the invisible-eye-finding edge case', built to demonstrate a real, verified rule-coverage gap): retinopathyStatus 'preProliferative' (R2) matched neither DM-004 ('proliferative' only) nor DM-008 ('background' only), and flagged-issues.js checked only 'proliferative' for FLAG-EYE-001 - so this persona used to fire NO eye-category rule or flag despite a real, sight-threatening finding. Fixed by adding DM-021 (high concern, matching DM-004/proliferative's urgency per the National Diabetic Eye Screening Programme's R1/R2/R3 grading and NICE NG28) and FLAG-EYE-003 (high priority). It still counts toward countComplications() (so it still depresses the score) and correctly blocks DM-017 ('no complications', which only tests for '' or 'none'). HbA1c 64 mmol/mol (hba1cScore 60, weight 4) folded with adherence 3/5->50 (weight 1) -> (60*4+50)/5=58, diet 3/5->50 (weight 1) -> (58*5+50)/6=56.333, TIR 55 (weight 1) -> (56.333*6+55)/7 -> 56.142857... -> round 56; one complication (the retinopathy) -> penalty 5 -> score 51. Expect controlLevel 'suboptimal' (score < 65), controlScore 51, fired rules DM-006 (HbA1c 64-85 suboptimal) AND DM-021 (pre-proliferative retinopathy, high) - previously DM-006 only. Flags: FLAG-HBA1C-002 (medium, hba1cValue 64 > hba1cTarget 53 with a non-blank unit) AND FLAG-EYE-003 (high) - previously FLAG-HBA1C-002 only.

personas.name: Critical - very poor control with active foot ulcer and unrecognised severe hypoglycaemia
personas.description: Critical-highest persona. HbA1c 97 mmol/mol (>=97 crosses both DM-001's >=86 threshold and FLAG-HBA1C-001's own >=97 threshold; hba1cScore 0, weight 4) folded with adherence 1/5->0 (weight 1) -> 0, diet 1/5->0 (weight 1) -> 0, TIR 8 (weight 1) -> (0*6+8)/7 = 1.142857 -> round 1; five complications counted (retinopathy proliferative, neuropathy symptoms, eGFR<60, ulcer present, previous CVD event) -> penalty min(25,30)=25 -> score max(1-25,0)=0. Expect controlLevel 'veryPoor', controlScore 0. Fired rules in registry order: DM-001 (HbA1c>=86), DM-002 (severe hypo), DM-003 (foot ulcer), DM-004 (proliferative retinopathy), DM-005 (eGFR<30), DM-007 (recurrent hypo, daily), DM-009 is skipped (eGFR 28 fails the 30-59 band, DM-005 already covers <30), DM-010 (microalbuminuria, ACR 22 > 3), DM-011 (neuropathy symptoms), DM-012 (poor adherence 1/5), DM-013 is skipped (BMI 33.8 < 35), DM-014 (poor diet 1/5), DM-015 (high distress 5/5) - 11 rules total. Flags after the stable priority sort: urgent FLAG-HBA1C-001, FLAG-HYPO-002 (daily frequency + severe hypo -> unawareness), FLAG-FOOT-001, FLAG-EYE-001; high FLAG-HYPO-001, FLAG-RENAL-001, FLAG-CVD-001 (previous CVD, on statin but NOT on antihypertensive), FLAG-PSYCH-001 (distress = 5), FLAG-CVD-002 (current smoker); medium FLAG-HBA1C-002 (97 > target 58), FLAG-FOOT-002 (footRiskCategory 'high'), FLAG-SELF-001 (poor diet + sedentary + poor adherence = 3 of 3 poor domains), FLAG-CVD-003 (systolic 168 >= 140) - 13 flags total. FLAG-MED-001 does NOT fire (on insulin, but hypoglycaemiaFrequency is 'daily' not '', so the 'without documented hypoglycaemia assessment' condition is false). FLAG-RENAL-002 does not fire (ACR 22 is between 3 and 30, i.e. microalbuminuria not macroalbuminuria - only DM-010, a fired rule, not FLAG-RENAL-002).
